title: Farm Real Estate Loans — Real Estate Taxes on Mortgaged Parcels and Protective Advances
content:
## Clauses

**1. Who pays.** The member pays the real estate taxes on every parcel mortgaged to a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage directly to the county.

**2. Verification.** The association verifies each tax year with the county treasurer and records the latest year verified paid and, when the treasurer reports an installment unpaid, the county delinquency date of the earliest one.

**3. Evidence.** A member's statement that the tax was paid is not verification; a county receipt or treasurer record is.

**4. Delinquency and the cure period.** When a tax year becomes delinquent under county rules, the member is notified, and a protective advance may be made only after more than the product's tax cure period in calendar days has passed since the county delinquency date of that tax year, counted with the delinquency date as day 0. The delinquency date is the one recorded on the loan from the treasurer's report.

**5. The advance.** The advance pays the delinquent tax, penalty and county interest as billed by the treasurer, is added to principal on the payment date, accrues interest at the contract rate, and carries the product's protective advance fee.

**6. One per tax year.** One protective advance is made per parcel tax year; an advance already recorded on the loan for the same tax year means no second advance for it.

## County delinquency dates (Nebraska)

| Tax installment | County delinquency date |
|---|---|
| First half | May 1 of the year after the tax year |
| Second half | September 1 of the year after the tax year |

## Cure-period boundary (hypothetical dates)

The first half of tax year 2025 becomes delinquent on 1 May 2026 (day 0). With a 30-day cure period:

| Date | Day count | Protective advance may be made? |
|---|---|---|
| 31 May 2026 | day 30 | no — 30 days have passed, not more than 30 |
| 1 June 2026 | day 31 | yes, if the tax has not been shown paid by a county receipt or treasurer record |

The second half of tax year 2025 becomes delinquent on 1 September 2026; day 30 is 1 October 2026 and the first day an advance may be made is 2 October 2026.

**What the advance looks like (hypothetical).** A treasurer bills USD 4210.00 of delinquent tax, penalty and county interest. The advance pays USD 4210.00 to the county, that amount is added to principal on the payment date and accrues interest at the contract rate from then, and the product's protective advance fee is assessed with it.
